== The Name of the Game ==
Please do think of another name. Calling a Lojban reform project ''Optimized Lojban'' (xagrai befo do) might mislead newcomers into thinking official Lojban is obsolete (which it isn't, at least as long as it's official) mu'o mi'e .[[User:iesk|iesk]]. 21:46, 22 oktobero 2013 (UTC)

::Oh, I see you went for ''La Bangu'' … I was about to propose ''Loglan 13'' (if you feel traditional ''and'' [http://www.hr-online.de/servlet/de.hr.cms.servlet.IMS?enc=d3M9aHJteXNxbCZibG9iSWQ9ODA5MSZpZD0zMDU1MDU0 piratey]) … Or perhaps ''lo jbanido (Loĵbanido),'' if you’re willing to accept an ill-boding name if it gets you a lame biconlingual pun. ;) mu'o mi'e .[[User:iesk|iesk]]. 13:41, 23 oktobero 2013 (UTC)
:::La Bangu is a method of teaching Lojban that uses modern trends in the active Lojban community. The most noticeable difference is cmevla=brivla which result in '''cu''' after cmevla. Otherwise SL and La Bangu can be made compatible in style.[[User:Gleki|gleki.is.my.name]] ([[User talk:Gleki|talk]]) 07:59, 24 avgusto 2014 (UTC)
